value.subject: gdp_per_capita
notes: indiaValue is the raw World Bank value; indiaValueDisplay is formatted for presentation only and is never an input to a calculation.
total is the number of eligible countries/economies holding a valid observation for that metric and year, so it can differ between metrics and years.
indiaYoY is null when either year has no stored observation or the previous value is not greater than zero; indiaYoYReason states which case applies.

overviewPlans.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM countries WHERE is_aggregate = 0

plan.detail: SEARCH countries USING COVERING INDEX idx_countries_is_aggregate (is_aggregate=?)

overviewPlans.sql:
SELECT 1 AS one
       FROM observations o
       JOIN countries c ON c.id = o.country_id
       WHERE o.indicator_id = ? AND c.is_aggregate = 0 AND o.value IS NOT NULL
       LIMIT 1

SELECT o.country_id AS iso3,
              c.name       AS name,
              o.year       AS year,
              o.value      AS value,
              o.value_raw  AS valueRaw
      FROM observations o
      JOIN countries c ON c.id = o.country_id
      WHERE o.indicator_id = ?
        AND o.year BETWEEN ? AND ?
        AND c.is_aggregate = 0
        AND o.value IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY o.year, o.country_id

        WHERE o.indicator_id=i.id AND c.is_aggregate=0 AND o.value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS hasData
        FROM indicators i WHERE i.metric_key IN (?,?,?,?)
